# Local Image Converter

> Free, open-source image converter that runs entirely in the browser. Files never leave your device: decoding and encoding happen locally, nothing is uploaded, no cookies, no analytics, no ads, no account.

- Input formats: HEIC/HEIF, WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG (any other image type the browser itself can decode may also work).
- Output formats: JPEG and PNG always; WebP and AVIF are offered only if the visitor's browser can encode them.
- Quality slider for JPEG, WebP and AVIF: 0.5 to 1.0, step 0.05, default 0.85. PNG output is lossless (slider has no effect).
- Batch: multiple files at once; each result downloads separately, or all results as one ZIP (converted-images.zip) when two or more succeed.
- No file-size limit is set by the tool; practical limits are the device's memory and the browser's canvas limits.
- Limitations: EXIF metadata (camera, GPS, date) is dropped and EXIF orientation is not applied, so some photos may appear rotated; for multi-image HEIC/HEIF only the first image is converted; JPEG output turns transparent areas white.
- HEIC/HEIF: if the browser cannot decode it natively, a WebAssembly build of libheif (LGPL-3.0) is loaded from the same site and runs locally.
- Tested in Chrome/Chromium, Firefox and a WebKit engine build; Safari on macOS and iOS/iPadOS is not fully tested yet.
- Languages: English, Russian (https://noclaudkit.com/image-converter/ru/), Chinese (https://noclaudkit.com/image-converter/zh/).
